text:
maria: Heads-up — starting migration of project-level API keys into the shared-buckets routing model today at 17:00 PT. Low-risk canary first, full rollout over 48h. Posting config + checks below.

aj: Quick Q — how will quota attribution work? We need per-project billing continuity, not aggregated to org.

maria: Good call. We plan to preserve effective_project for billing and telemetry. Routing will select key from shared bucket but set `X-Effective-Project` on the request for metering.

devon: From telemetry side, we need the effective project in traces and logs (span tags) and a discrete sampling path for pre/post migration to compare token counts. Can we add `auth.effective_project` and `auth.origin_bucket` tags?

maria: Yes — proposal: attach tags `auth.origin` (original key id), `auth.effective_project`, `auth.routing_bucket`. Those feed into Console dashboard and billing pipelines.

aj: What about service accounts and impersonation flows? If a request is via a delegated SA, we must not lose the impersonator identity.

sophie: UX note — console should show both the key name users entered and the effective project it mapped to. We should add a small banner in the key modal: "This key routes to shared bucket X and counts against project Y".

maria: Fallback rules: if project unlinked from org, fallback to `org.default` bucket and create an audit event. We'll also surface the fallback in Console -> key usage panel.

devon: Can we standardize the header as `X-Effective-Project: <project-id>` and log `auth.method=shared_bucket`? Makes parsing easier.

aj: Also need TTL/rotation behavior clarified. Will rotation of the underlying shared key invalidate user-visible key immediately? That could break short-lived integrations.

maria: Rotation is behind a lazy proxy: existing tokens remain valid until expiry; we rotate underlying pool and do seamless swap. Only admins revoking a key will immediately fail.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: deploy started for `auth-shared-buckets` canary -> infra-2 at 2024-11-06T17:00:12Z

sophie: Can we gate the console change behind a feature flag? `feature.auth.shared_buckets_ui` so docs + UX land after backend is stable.

maria: yep. We'll push backend canary first, then enable `feature.auth.shared_buckets_ui` for 10% orgs.

devon: Telemetry keys required: `auth.origin`, `auth.effective_project`, `auth.routing_bucket`, `auth.method`. Also add `auth.fallback` boolean when fallback occurs.

aj: I'll add end-to-end tests: billing attribution, per-project quotas, and a regression test where project->org mapping flips during request.

maria: config snippet (canary):
```
auth.routing:
  mode: shared_bucket
  canary_percent: 1
  fallback: org_default
  headers_to_emit:
    - X-Effective-Project
```

aj: lgtm. one more ask — surface per-route latency breakdown in Console when routing occurs, so SRE can see if the proxy adds overhead.

sophie: adding to UX checklist.

maria: Thanks all — please add blockers by EOD. Rolling this out in waves, ping if you want to be on the canary list. :rocket:
